name: ANIMUS_MASTERY_V1
offer_gate: The composed Character authority offers ANIMUS_MASTERY_V1 when it can serve a current-session-fenced durable mastery query. Unsupported authorities remove it from every offer set. Historical mastery queries do not require a currently available Soulpit arena; acquisition remains gated by that activity's existing owner. Command 232 is refused unless capability 168 was selected.
